services.description:
Discover Delhi, Agra, and Jaipur on this private six-day Luxury Golden Triangle Tour with Heritage Hotels. Combine guided sightseeing with the opportunity to stay at heritage properties and luxury hotels selected according to your preferences and budget. Hotel accommodation is not included in the tour package and is booked separately.

Explore Old Delhi's bazaars, Jama Masjid, a Sikh temple, and Qutub Minar. Continue to Agra for a guided visit to Agra Fort, sunset views of the Taj Mahal from Mehtab Bagh, and a sunrise visit to the mausoleum the following morning.

Visit Fatehpur Sikri on your journey to Jaipur, with Abhaneri's Chand Baori available as an alternative or additional stop by prior arrangement. Discover Jaipur's Amber Fort, City Palace, and Jantar Mantar, with photo stops at Jal Mahal and Hawa Mahal.

Travel in a private air-conditioned car with an experienced chauffeur. The tour ends with drop-off in Jaipur on the sixth day. Guide services are available in English, Spanish, German, Italian, and French. Sightseeing, hotel suggestions, and tour length can be tailored to your preferences.

Hotel accommodation, breakfast, and all monument and heritage-site entry tickets are excluded and must be arranged or paid for separately.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Delhi and Hotel Transfer
itinerary.description:
A member of the team will welcome you at Delhi Airport, and your chauffeur will transfer you to your separately booked hotel.

Suggested properties include The Claridges, Maidens Hotel, or The Imperial, according to your preferences, budget, and availability. If you arrive early, introductory sightseeing can be arranged according to the available time. Stay overnight in Delhi.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Old Delhi Sightseeing and Sikh Temple Visit
itinerary.description:
After breakfast at your own expense, meet your professional tour guide and chauffeur at your separately booked hotel.

Visit Jama Masjid, explore Old Delhi's colourful bazaars on a rickshaw ride, and stop for exterior photographs at the Red Fort. Continue with a visit to a Sikh temple.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: New Delhi Landmarks and Qutub Minar
itinerary.description:
Drive past New Delhi's landmarks, including India Gate, Rashtrapati Bhavan, and Parliament House, with photo opportunities where access permits.

Visit Qutub Minar with your guide, then return to your separately booked hotel for your second overnight stay in Delhi.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Drive to Agra and Hotel Check-in
itinerary.description:
After breakfast at your own expense, check out and travel to Agra in your private air-conditioned car. The journey takes approximately 3–4 hours, depending on traffic.

Check in to your separately booked hotel and take time to relax. Suggested options include The Grand Imperial or Trident Agra, with The Oberoi Amarvilas as a premium alternative.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Agra Fort and Taj Mahal Sunset Views
itinerary.description:
Meet your professional guide and explore Agra Fort, discovering its Mughal history, palaces, and courtyards.

In the evening, visit Mehtab Bagh for sunset views of the Taj Mahal across the Yamuna River. Return to your separately booked hotel for an overnight stay in Agra.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Taj Mahal Sunrise Visit
itinerary.description:
Meet your tour guide at the scheduled time of 6 am for an approximately 2–3 hour visit to the Taj Mahal. Coordinate the departure time with the seasonal sunrise.

Admire the white marble mausoleum from the outside and inside while your guide explains its history, architecture, and decorative details. Return to your separately booked hotel for breakfast at your own expense before checking out.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Fatehpur Sikri or Abhaneri and Drive to Jaipur
itinerary.description:
Travel towards Jaipur with a guided visit to Fatehpur Sikri, the historic red sandstone city that once served as Mughal Emperor Akbar's capital.

If preferred, Chand Baori in Abhaneri can be arranged as an alternative stop. Visiting both sites can also be discussed in advance, subject to available time and your agreed itinerary.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Hotel Check-in and Overnight in Jaipur
itinerary.description:
Upon arrival in Jaipur, check in to your separately booked hotel. Suggested options include Samode Haveli or Rajmahal Palace, with Rambagh Palace and The Oberoi Rajvilas as premium alternatives.

Enjoy the first of two overnight stays in Jaipur.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Amber Fort and Jaipur Photo Stops
itinerary.description:
After breakfast at your own expense, meet your professional tour guide at 8 am and begin your Jaipur sightseeing with a visit to Amber Fort.

Explore its courtyards and palaces, then stop for photographs at Jal Mahal and the distinctive facade of Hawa Mahal.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: City Palace and Jantar Mantar
itinerary.description:
Visit City Palace in Jaipur's Old City and discover its royal heritage and museum collections, including textiles, costumes, and paintings.

Continue to Jantar Mantar, where your guide will explain the observatory's large astronomical instruments and their uses.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Optional Evening Experience and Overnight Stay
itinerary.description:
Personalise your evening with an optional cooking class or an elephant encounter, with arrangements and costs confirmed in advance. Elephant riding is not planned.

You may also leave the evening free to relax. Return to your separately booked hotel for your second overnight stay in Jaipur.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Breakfast, Check-out and Jaipur Drop-off
itinerary.description:
After breakfast at your own expense, check out of your separately booked hotel. Your chauffeur will transfer you to Jaipur Airport, another hotel, or your preferred location in Jaipur.

Your Luxury Golden Triangle Tour with Heritage Hotels ends in Jaipur.
